comparison.equivalence_note: Merged weights are the same LoRA merge as the seed42 adapter, and the earlier 5-sample merge equivalence was 5/5 identical. This is a dtype/device numerical divergence, not a deployment weight mismatch; the adapter GPU result remains the official number and the merged CPU result is a deployment diagnostic only.

timing.note: The wall time (~53.8 min) is inflated by host CPU contention/stalls during this run; the per-sample compute diagnostics and the earlier 50-sample 2-thread latency (mean 1.57 s/sample) are the cleaner timing references. Do not report the wall as a benchmark.
timing.stall_note: a single sample recorded 1556.3s during a host CPU stall; excluding that outlier the median is 1.465 s/sample, consistent with the earlier 1.57 s/sample 2-thread deploy latency.
